newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore PM says no new elections until 2002.
newsitem.headline: Singapore PM says no new elections until 2002.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong, fresh from a resounding poll victory earlier this month, said he would not call the next general elections until serving out his full term in mid-2002.

Speaking at the swearing-in ceremony of his new cabinet on Saturday, Goh said the full term would give him and his team time to assess new members of parliament and determine who would be the best leaders in the future.
Goh's party, the ruling People's Action party (PAP) rolled to victory in January 2 general elections, winning 81 of 83 parliamentary seats.
Goh said he was readying the next generation of PAP leaders "so that they can take over the torch without faltering."
In unveiling his new Cabinet last week, Goh shuffled portfolios among existing ministers but brought no new faces into his senior team.
